blocks.text: Joyce Ching and her non-showbiz husband, Kevin Alimon, have welcomed the newest addition to their family, baby boy Enzo Rafael. The actress-content creator showed moments from when she gave birth to her second child at the hospital, through her Instagram page on Saturday, Oct. 31. Aside from Ching and Alimon, also present at the hospital to celebrate the arrival of Enzo Rafael was his older sister, Oli. “Officially a family of four,” Ching captioned her post. “Hello, Enzo Rafael!
